battle.name: 撥換城之戰
battle.brief: 公元717年（開元五年），倭馬亞王朝聯合吐蕃與突騎施圍攻撥換城（姑墨州，今新疆阿克蘇）與大石城（溫肅州，今烏什），副大都護湯嘉惠引葛邏祿與十姓可汗阿史那獻之眾解圍，是唐與阿拉伯的第二次直接接觸。卡面羅馬弩砲未至西域，但大食的投石、撞錘與雲梯同出希臘—羅馬—薩珊攻城技術一脈。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 撥換城之戰爆發於唐玄宗開元五年（717年），是唐朝安西都護府與阿拉伯倭馬亞王朝在天山南麓、塔里木盆地北緣一帶的正面衝突，交戰形勢由三個政治集團拼成。唐方的主體是西域都護府（安西都護府，治龜茲，今新疆庫車），總部設在安西四鎮防區，兵源包含漢兵、屯田戍卒與西域屬國的部眾，指揮權歸安西都護與副大都護，開元五年實際統兵者為副大都護湯嘉惠。外圍由兩支西域部眾擔任機動主力：一是三姓葛邏祿，其首領為十姓可汗阿史那獻；二是其後在碎葉與七河一帶立國的突騎施，時任首領蘇祿，事後被唐玄宗封為忠順可汗。阿方是據河中（粟特地區，即今中亞澤拉夫尚河流域）的倭馬亞王朝軍隊，與吐蕃、突騎施合流後組成聯軍：倭馬亞方面以哈里發的旗號調兵，吐蕃出高原騎兵，突騎施出天山北麓的遊牧弓騎。聯軍的目標是拔除安西四鎮、切斷唐與西域的通道，把費爾干納與七河的粟特商路握在己手。值得留意的是，717年的河中並非鐵板一塊：阿拔斯一派的支持者已在粟特活動，阿布·穆斯林當時正以反抗者身份在河中召集人馬，倭馬亞的處境遠不如表面穩固。這一戰是唐與阿拉伯的第二次直接接觸，第一次是開元三年（715年）的拔汗那之戰。
countriesEn: The Battle of Bolchu broke out in the fifth year of the Kaiyuan era, 717 CE, when the Tang Western Regions Protectorate and the Umayyad Caliphate came to open conflict along the southern Tian Shan and the northern rim of the Tarim Basin. Three political blocks were welded into the opposing side. The Tang side was built around the Anxi Protectorate, headquartered at Kucha (present-day Kuche, Xinjiang), whose headquarters sat inside the defensive belt of the four garrisons of Anxi. Its manpower mixed Chinese soldiers, garrison troops from the state farms and the levies of the dependent states of the Western Regions, and command lay with the Protector and his deputy; the man actually holding the field in 717 was the deputy protector Tang Jiahui. Around him two bodies of Western Regions tribal cavalry supplied the manoeuvre: the Three Lineages of the Karluq, headed by the qaghan of the Ten Lineages, Ashina Xian; and the Türgesh, who would shortly establish themselves at Suoyab in the Seven Rivers, under their leader Suluk, who was afterwards granted the title of Prince of Loyal Obedience by Emperor Xuanzong. The Arab side was an Umayyad army based in Transoxiana (the Sogdian lands, that is, the Zeravshan basin of modern Central Asia), which had joined forces with the Tibetan Empire and the Türgesh to form a coalition. The Umayyads mustered under the banner of the caliph, the Tibetans sent highland cavalry, and the Türgesh sent nomadic mounted archers from the northern slopes of the Tian Shan. The aim of the coalition was to pull out the four Anxi garrisons, sever Tang communication with the Western Regions, and take control of the Sogdian trade road through Farghana and the Seven Rivers. It should be noted that Transoxiana in 717 was not a single block: supporters of the Abbasid line were already active in Sogdia, and Abu Muslim was at that very moment rallying followers in Transoxiana in the role of a rebel, so the Umayyad position was far less secure than it looked on the surface. This was the second direct contact between China and the Arabs; the first had been the Battle of Balkh in the third year of Kaiyuan, 715 CE.
people: 戰役中留下姓名的唐方人物有兩位。一是安西都護府副大都護湯嘉惠，開元五年奉命經略西域，聯軍圍困撥換城與大石城之時，他調集三姓葛邏祿的軍隊與十姓可汗阿史那獻一同出擊，終於驅散圍城之敵，是這場戰役真正的唐方統帥。二是十姓可汗阿史那獻，作為西域遊牧部落的首領，他率本部眾與唐軍協同作戰，是打開聯軍側背的關鍵力量；葛邏祿、突騎施一系皆出自阿史那氏，與唐既合作又防備，忠順可汗的封號是戰後才由玄宗頒下。稍早的關鍵人物是監察御史張孝嵩：開元三年（715年）阿拉伯與吐蕃共立阿了達為拔汗那王並進攻拔汗那，張孝嵩率戎族部落兵一萬餘人自龜茲出發西行數千里，破阿了達三城、俘斬千餘人，一舉奠定唐在西域的聲威；到717年他已不在前線，但他兩年前的勝利正是聯軍再度東進的直接誘因。突騎施首領蘇祿是戰後的關鍵人物：此役之後突騎施正式歸附唐朝，蘇祿獲封忠順可汗、佔據碎葉，隨後數度進攻費爾干納的阿拉伯堡壘，改變了中亞的權力版圖。阿拉伯方面的指揮官姓名在漢文史籍中大多失傳，只留下「哈里發」統兵、遣使贖俘的記載；河中方面還有阿布·穆斯林在活動，他此時尚未奪取政權，卻是日後推翻倭馬亞的關鍵人物。
peopleEn: Only two Tang figures are named in the records of this battle. The first was Tang Jiahui, deputy protector of the Anxi Protectorate, who in the fifth year of Kaiyuan was charged with the conduct of Western Regions affairs. When the coalition besieged Bolchu and Dashicheng, he brought up the troops of the Three Lineages of the Karluq together with the qaghan of the Ten Lineages, Ashina Xian, and in the end scattered the besiegers; he was the real Tang commander of the engagement. The second was that qaghan, Ashina Xian. As a chief of a nomadic Western Regions tribe he led his own people in concert with the Tang army, and it was his mounted wing that opened the coalition's flank. The Karluq and the Türgesh both descended from the Ashina clan; their relationship with the Tang was one of cooperation laced with mistrust, and the title of Prince of Loyal Obedience was only conferred on Suluk by Emperor Xuanzong after the battle. The decisive figure slightly earlier was the investigating censor Zhang Xiaosong. In the third year of Kaiyuan, 715 CE, the Arabs and the Tibetans jointly installed Ala'da as king of Farghana and marched on the country. Zhang Xiaosong led more than ten thousand tribal soldiers west out of Kucha, advanced a thousand li, stormed three strongholds of Ala'da and took or killed more than a thousand men, fixing the Tang's reputation in the Western Regions in a single blow. By 717 he was no longer on the frontier, but his victory of two years earlier was the direct provocation that brought the coalition east again. Suluk, chief of the Türgesh, is the key figure of the aftermath: after this battle the Türgesh formally submitted to the Tang, Suluk was made Prince of Loyal Obedience and occupied Suoyab, and he then struck the Arab fortresses in Farghana several times, redrawing the balance of power in Central Asia. The names of the Arab commanders have largely been lost in the Chinese sources, which preserve only the fact that the caliph mustered the troops and sent emissaries to ransom the prisoners. On the Transoxianan side Abu Muslim was also active; he had not yet taken power, but he was the man who would one day overthrow the Umayyads.
kits: 這張卡的兵器是羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）：扭力弩砲，一發一具箭，羅馬人用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。必須老實說明，羅馬弩砲本身並沒有出現在717年的西域戰場，唐軍也不會使用這種武器；但它可以當作攻城技術譜系的一個座標來讀。倭馬亞王朝的攻城器械，經由希臘化世界、拜占庭與薩珊波斯一路傳承，與羅馬的扭力投射器同源：圍城用的配重撞錘、雲梯、壕溝與投石，本質上都是把圍城變成一次工程問題的同一套辦法。撥換城之戰裡，阿里一方擺開的正是這一門技術：先合圍，再斷糧，最後壓上攻城器械；防守的唐軍與西域守軍則以城牆、弓弩、拒馬、鹿角與陷馬坑應對，並靠烽燧把警訊送往龜茲。真正投入這場戰役的裝備可以這樣盤點：唐軍直屬部隊為漢兵步騎混編，配長槊、標槍、唐刀與強弩，開元年間部分部隊已有披甲的具裝騎兵，但此役戰史不記其使用；西域部眾以弓馬為主，葛邏祿、突騎施的騎兵善長馳射與包抄圍獵，裝備以皮甲、彎弓、長矛為要；吐蕃出動的是適應高原與乾旱的馬兵；大食方面除圍城步兵外，還有自河中、呼羅珊一路東來的騎兵。軍營、糧秣與攻城器物的搬運靠長隊商旅的駱駝，穿越帕米爾與天山通道的聯軍補給線，比唐軍自龜茲南下的路更長更脆；營帳、糧草與攻城器物的運送，是雙方都最脆弱的一環。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered bolt thrower that fires a single heavy bolt per shot; the Romans used it to break down Greek city walls and, in the end, the Greek system of city-states. It has to be said plainly that the Roman scorpio never appeared on a Central Asian battlefield in 717, and Tang troops certainly did not use one. It can, however, be read as a coordinate in the genealogy of siegecraft. The siege equipment of the Umayyad Caliphate, handed down through the Hellenistic world, Byzantium and Sasanian Persia, shares its ancestry with the Roman torsion artillery: the counterweight ram, the scaling ladder, the trench and the stone-thrower are all the same answer to the same problem, that of turning a siege into an engineering exercise. That is the art the Arab side deployed at Bolchu: encircle first, cut the supplies next, and only then bring up the siege machines. The Tang and the local garrisons answered with walls, bows and crossbows, chevaux-de-frise, sharpened stakes and pits, and passed the alarm onward to Kucha by beacon fires. The equipment actually committed to this battle can be listed as follows. The Tang regulars were mixed Han foot and cavalry, armed with long spears, javelins, Tang sabres and powerful crossbows; by the Kaiyuan era some units already fought as armoured mounted lancers, though the records of this battle do not mention their use. The Western Regions levies fought with bow and horse above all; the Karluq and Türgesh cavalry were skilled at the galloped shot and at encircling quarry, and their gear was leather armour, composite bows and long spears. The Tibetans brought the mounted troops used to high altitude and to arid country. The Arabs had their siege infantry, and cavalry that had marched east from Transoxiana and Khurasan. Their camps, grain and siege machines travelled on the camels of the long caravans; the coalition's supply line across the Pamirs and the Tian Shan passes was longer and far more fragile than the Tang's own road south from Kucha. The moving of tents, grain and artillery was the weakest point on both sides.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術核心是攻方合圍、節制反包圍。聯軍的企圖很清楚：用倭馬亞的步卒與攻城器械、吐蕃的高原騎兵、突騎施的遊牧弓騎，三股力量同時壓上撥換城（姑墨州，今新疆阿克蘇市）與大石城（溫肅州，今新疆烏什縣），切斷兩城與龜茲之間的交通，讓安西四鎮孤立；一旦唐軍放棄西域，費爾干納的粟特商路與七河牧場就可以被聯軍獨吞。圍城方按的是標準次序：合圍，斷絕糧道與水源，游騎掠取城外耕地與運糧隊伍，待守軍耗盡再以雲梯、撞錘、投石壓上。唐方的應對不是死守，而是解圍：湯嘉惠以本部在正面與城下維持營壘，用拒馬、鹿角與弓弩齊射壓制試圖攀城的敵兵，不讓聯軍把圍城變成屠場；主力則交給葛邏祿與十姓可汗阿史那獻率領的騎兵，捨近就遠，繞到聯軍背後切斷其糧道與退路，再在聯軍陣線被拉長的瞬間發動衝鋒，迫其放棄攻城退回。騎兵戰的勝負關鍵在於誰先發現對方的側翼，誰先脫離接觸，誰的馬力還剩多少。突騎施的加入最微妙：他們是遊牧部眾，與阿拉伯人有共同的掠奪目標，卻也在爭奪牧場與商路分贊；戰敗之後正是靠這層矛盾轉而倒向唐朝，隨即用唐國的號令去攻費爾干納的阿拉伯堡壘。補給線同樣決定成敗：唐軍的糧食來自龜茲、姑墨、溫肅一線的屯田與屬國徵發，聯軍的糧食要從費爾干納與河中一路運來，人畜越多、水越難，遲滯一日就多一分被反包圍的危險。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of this war was encirclement by the attackers answered by a counter-encirclement from the defenders' side. The coalition's plan was plain: the Umayyad infantry and siege machines, the Tibetan highland cavalry and the nomadic mounted archers of the Türgesh were to press on Bolchu (Kumo prefecture, present-day Aksu in Xinjiang) and Dashicheng (Wensu prefecture, present-day Wushi) at the same time, severing the two cities' communications with Kucha and leaving the four garrisons of Anxi isolated. Once the Tang gave up the Western Regions, the Sogdian road through Farghana and the pastures of the Seven Rivers would fall entirely to the coalition. The besiegers followed the standard sequence: close the ring, cut the supply route and the water, send light horse out to strip the fields outside the walls and to intercept the grain convoys, and only when the defenders had been worn down bring up the ladders, the rams and the stone-throwers. The Tang answer was not to sit still but to relieve the siege. Tang Jiahui held his own troops on the front and at the foot of the walls, keeping a camp protected by chevaux-de-frise and stakes and answering the storming parties with volleys from bow and crossbow, so that the siege did not turn into a massacre. The striking force was given to the cavalry of the Karluq and of the qaghan Ashina Xian, who took the longer way round, got behind the coalition, cut its supplies and its line of retreat, and charged at the moment the enemy line was stretched out to its full length, forcing it to abandon the siege and withdraw. In mounted combat what decides the matter is who first sees the enemy's flank, who first breaks contact, and whose horses still have strength in them. The presence of the Türgesh was the most delicate element of all. As nomads they shared the coalition's appetite for plunder, yet they were also competing for pastures and for a share of the trade; it was precisely on the strength of that contradiction that they turned to the Tang after their defeat, and then used Tang recognition to attack the Arab fortresses in Farghana. Supply decided the outcome as much as tactics: the Tang drew their grain from the state farms and the levies of Kucha, Kumo and Wensu, while the coalition's grain had to be dragged from Farghana and Transoxiana, and the more men and beasts a column carried the harder it was to find water, so every day of delay was another day of growing danger of being counter-encircled.
data: 關於這場戰役，漢文史料留下的數字不多，能夠核對的有以下幾組。時間：開元五年（717年），是唐與阿拉伯帝國的第二次直接衝突；此前三年（開元三年、715年）已有拔汗那之戰。距離與行程：拔汗那之戰中，監察御史張孝嵩率戎族部落兵一萬餘人自龜茲出發，向西挺進數千里，攻下數百座城池，在連城（今納曼干州一帶）由中午至傍晚攻克阿了達三座城堡，俘獲、斬首合計一千餘人，阿了達僅帶數名騎兵逃入山谷。一千餘名俘斬是這批史料中最大的數字。717年之役本身，兩軍的總兵力、攻城器物數量、死傷與俘虜人數都沒有留下可核的記載，只留下「許多阿拉伯士卒被俘，哈里發支付贖金後將其釋放」一語，以及聯軍放棄圍城、阿拉伯人退出河中北部的結果。地理：撥換城在姑墨州治（今新疆阿克蘇市），大石城在溫肅州治（今新疆烏什縣），兩城相距數十華里；戰場位於今新疆與吉爾吉斯斯坦接壤的西天山一帶。年代標尺：三十四年後的怛羅斯戰役（751年）才是阿拉伯人在河中與唐軍正面交鋒並取勝的著名戰役，本戰只是他們北進的一次受阻。具體的傷亡與損耗數字諸說並存且多有缺漏，本條只採可以指名的記載，不作推算；至於本卡所列的月份，確月史無明文，此處只是依唐軍秋季出兵的編年慣例所作的編排，並非史籍明載。
dataEn: The Chinese sources preserve few numbers for this battle, and only a few sets of figures can be checked. Date: the fifth year of Kaiyuan, 717 CE, and the second direct conflict between the Tang and the Arab empire; three years earlier, in the third year of Kaiyuan, 715 CE, there had already been the Battle of Balkh. Distance and marching: in that battle of Balkh the investigating censor Zhang Xiaosong led more than ten thousand tribal soldiers west out of Kucha, advanced a thousand li, took several hundred cities, and between noon and dusk stormed three strongholds of Ala'da at Liancheng (in the neighbourhood of present-day Namangan), capturing or killing more than a thousand men, while Ala'da escaped into the hills with only a few riders. The thousand prisoners and dead is the largest number in this body of texts. For the battle of 717 itself no verifiable figures survive for the total strength of either army, for the number of siege machines, or for casualties and prisoners; the sources preserve only the statement that many Arab soldiers were taken and were released after the caliph paid a ransom, together with the outcome that the coalition abandoned the siege and the Arabs withdrew from northern Transoxiana. Geography: Bolchu lay at the seat of Kumo prefecture (present-day Aksu, Xinjiang) and Dashicheng at the seat of Wensu prefecture (present-day Wushi, Xinjiang); the two were a few tens of li apart. The battlefield lay in the western Tian Shan, along the border between present-day Xinjiang and Kyrgyzstan. As a dating marker: the famous engagement in which the Arabs met a Tang army in Transoxiana and won was the Battle of Talas thirty-four years later, in 751; this battle was only a check to their northward advance. Exact casualty and loss figures are contested and mostly missing, and this account uses only the statements that can be named, without extrapolation. As for the month shown on this card, the sources give no exact month; the placement follows only the Tang calendar habit of campaigning in the autumn and is an editorial arrangement rather than a documentary date.
cause: 撥換城之戰的起因，是阿拉伯帝國在715到717年間試圖把中亞的粟特地區收入囊中，而唐朝的安西都護府正卡在這條通道上。開元三年（715年），阿拉伯與吐蕃攜手在拔汗那（費爾干納谷地）另立阿了達為王，發兵攻滅原來的拔汗那王；原王逃到龜茲向安西都護府求救，張孝嵩率兵萬餘西征，一戰破三城，使阿拉伯人在費爾干納的擴張受挫。兩年之後，倭馬亞王朝再攻河中，目標已不限於拔汗那一地，而是直指安西四鎮：一旦拿下龜茲、焉耆、于闐、疏勒，唐朝在天山南北的據點與絲路的西段控制權都會崩解，粟特商人、昭武九姓與吐火羅諸國也會被捲入新的宗主權力關係。突騎施的加入有其自身邏輯：葛邏祿、突騎施一系在七河與天山北麓遊牧，趁阿拉伯與唐朝互相消耗而擴張勢力，既想藉聯軍的力量攻入安西腹地，也想保住自己的牧場與商路分贊。吐蕃參戰則是唐蕃在西域對抗的延伸：吐蕃自七世紀末以來就在爭奪西域的霸權，與阿拉伯攜手打唐是它的既定策略；而阿拉伯人一時也沒有餘力再與吐蕃單獨開戰。三方的利益並不一致，這種不一致既造出了717年的聯軍，也解釋了它為什麼會在一次失敗之後立刻瓦解。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the Battle of Bolchu was the attempt of the Arab empire, between 715 and 717, to take the Sogdian lands of Central Asia into its grasp, while the Tang Anxi Protectorate stood squarely across that corridor. In the third year of Kaiyuan, 715 CE, the Arabs and the Tibetans joined hands in Farghana, installed Ala'da as king, and marched against the former king of Farghana; the displaced ruler fled to Kucha to seek the Anxi Protectorate, and Zhang Xiaosong marched west with more than ten thousand men, storming three cities in one blow and checking the Arab expansion in Farghana. Two years later the Umayyads struck at Transoxiana again, and the objective was no longer Farghana alone but the four garrisons of Anxi: with Kucha, Yanqi, Khotan and Khara taken, the Tang foothold north and south of the Tian Shan and the western half of the silk road would all collapse, and the Sogdian merchants, the Nine Surnames of Zhao and the Tocharian states would be pulled into a new lordly order. The Türgesh had their own reasons for joining. The Karluq and Türgesh ranged as nomads over the Seven Rivers and the northern slopes of the Tian Shan, and while the Arabs and the Tang wore each other down they enlarged their own position, hoping both to use the coalition to strike into the heart of Anxi and to keep the pastures and their share of the trade. Tibet's participation was the extension of the Tang-Tibetan struggle in the Western Regions: since the late seventh century the Tibetan Empire had been contesting the hegemony of the Western Regions, and joining the Arabs against the Tang was its standing strategy, while the Arabs in turn had no strength to spare for a separate war with Tibet. The three parties did not want the same thing, and that inconsistency is what produced the coalition of 717 as well as what dissolved it so quickly after one defeat.
impact: 這一戰的直接後果，是阿拉伯人退出河中北部，唐朝保住了安西四鎮與天山南麓的絲路通道。更深一層的影響落在突騎施身上：戰敗的突騎施沒有再與阿拉伯人合作到底，反而正式歸附唐朝，唐玄宗授其首領蘇祿忠順可汗的封號，承認突騎施佔據碎葉城；蘇祿此後在唐國的支持與默許下多次出擊費爾干納，奪取阿拉伯人經營的幾乎全部堡壘，使昭武九姓與吐火羅諸國重新回到唐的宗主體系之下。中亞的權力版圖因此倒向唐朝一側：粟特商路維持在唐與突騎施的保護之下，羅馬—波斯—伊斯蘭體系在河中的前沿被推回錫爾河一線。阿拉伯帝國方面的長期代價也在此埋下：717年的河中已潛伏著反抗倭馬亞的勢力，阿布·穆斯林在粟特召集人馬，種下阿拔斯革命的種子，三十三年後（750年）阿拔斯家族推翻倭馬亞王朝、建立阿拔斯哈里發國，而這場被阿拉伯人視為北進失敗的戰役，也就被重新解讀為兩大哈里發國爭奪中亞時的第一個回合。史家由此確立了一個判斷：唐在西亞與中亞的接觸比人們原先想像的更早、更靠西，也更早與歐亞兩端的帝國正面相遇；開元年間的西域經營之所以能壓住三方混戰，正因為安西都護府把防禦、屯田、冊封與商道保護綁成了一套可以運作的制度。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the battle was that the Arabs withdrew from northern Transoxiana and the Tang held on to the four garrisons of Anxi and to the silk road along the southern Tian Shan. The deeper effect fell on the Türgesh. Defeated, they did not go on cooperating with the Arabs; instead they formally submitted to the Tang, and Emperor Xuanzong granted their chief Suluk the title of Prince of Loyal Obedience and recognised the Türgesh's occupation of Suoyab. Suluk then struck at Farghana again and again with Tang support and Tang acquiescence, taking from the Arabs almost every fortress they held there, and the Nine Surnames of Zhao and the Tocharian states fell back into the Tang's client system. The balance of Central Asia tipped accordingly: the Sogdian trade road stayed under the protection of the Tang and the Türgesh, and the outposts of the Roman-Persian-Islamic world in Transoxiana were pushed back to the Syr Darya. The Arab empire's long bill was also sown here. In 717 Transoxiana already seethed with a movement against the Umayyads: Abu Muslim was raising men in Sogdia, planting the seed of the Abbasid revolution. Thirty-three years later, in 750, the Abbasids overthrew the Umayyads and founded the Abbasid Caliphate, and this battle, remembered by the Arabs as their failed northward advance, was reinterpreted as the first round between the two great caliphates for Central Asia. Historians have accordingly fixed on a judgment: Tang contact with West Asia and Central Asia came earlier and further west than was once supposed, and met the empires at both ends of Eurasia sooner than expected. The Western Regions policy of the Kaiyuan years was able to hold back a three-way war precisely because the Anxi Protectorate tied defence, state farming, investiture and the protection of the trade routes into a single working system.
result: 結果是聯軍敗退。倭馬亞王朝、吐蕃與突騎施的聯軍在撥換城與大石城兩處圍城失利，攻城器械與糧隊被毀或被截，阿拉伯人放棄圍城，退出河中北部，唐朝一方解了兩城之圍。許多阿拉伯士卒被俘，後來由哈里發支付贖金獲得釋放，這是漢文史籍對這場戰役唯一保存下來的具體善後程序。戰後，阿拉伯人退出河中北部；突騎施歸附唐朝，蘇祿被封忠順可汗並佔據碎葉城，隨即轉而攻打費爾干納的阿拉伯堡壘，把昭武九姓與吐火羅諸國重新拉回唐的宗主體系。安西四鎮與天山南北的絲路通道安然無恙，這是唐玄宗開元年間西域經營最順利的一役。須要說明的是，關於戰役本身的細節——出兵的確切時間、兵力、攻城器物與死傷數字——漢文史籍記載十分稀疏，許多方面只有結果而沒有過程，中外史家在這一點上並無一致；本條所列的，是可以指名與核對的部分，其餘多屬諸說並存。
resultEn: The result was the defeat of the coalition. The joint force of the Umayyad Caliphate, the Tibetan Empire and the Türgesh failed in both sieges, at Bolchu and at Dashicheng; siege machines and grain convoys were destroyed or cut off, the Arabs abandoned the siege and withdrew from northern Transoxiana, and the Tang relieved the two cities. Many Arab soldiers were taken prisoner and were later released once the caliph paid the ransom, the only concrete procedure of settlement that the Chinese sources preserve for this war. In its aftermath the Arabs were out of northern Transoxiana; the Türgesh submitted to the Tang, Suluk was made Prince of Loyal Obedience and took up Suoyab, and he turned at once on the Arab fortresses in Farghana, drawing the Nine Surnames of Zhao and the Tocharian states back into the Tang's client system. The four garrisons of Anxi and the silk road north and south of the Tian Shan were left intact, which makes this one of the smoothest Western Regions operations of Emperor Xuanzong's Kaiyuan years. It must be said that the details of the battle itself — the exact time of the sortie, the numbers engaged, the siege machines and the casualties — are very thinly recorded in the Chinese histories, in many respects giving only the outcome and none of the process, and foreign and Chinese historians do not agree on them. What is set out here are the points that can be named and checked; the rest remains a matter of competing accounts.
